page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening): one text column, with marginal notes in the left margin. At the right edge, the neighbouring page is only partly visible and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: & inauditis taxationibus miserrimè o-nerati. Quae scelera, licèt ipsius violen-tam mortem demùm maturauerint: tamen ex coniuratoribus (quos recen-set Suetonius) neminem Christianum legimus, vel Christiano affinem, imò Clemens, saeuiente hac persecutione Romanus Episcopus, licèt ipse Caesarem genere attigerit, Niceph. lib.2.cap.5. fratresque habuerit Faustum & Faustinianum Christianos, & verè generosos Duces: in illis Canonibus Apostolicis, quae ipsius nomine circumferuntur, tantùm abest, ut eos ad Imperatorem vel veneno, vel gladio, vel puluere tormentario è medio aufe-rendum hortaretur, ut ab omni adver-sus illum, suosque inferiores ministros, contumelia hoc Canone prorsus absti-nendum praecipiat. Can. 83. Quisquis Imperatorem, aut Magistratum contumelia affecerit, supplicium luito; & quidem si Clericus sit deponitor, si laicus à Communione remouetor.

page.notes: The right-hand neighbouring page is cut off at the scan edge and is not transcribed. "maturauerint·" ends with a raised point as printed, and I have copied it as a colon. The marginal note marks k and 1 are superscripts in the text. The word "adver-sus" is printed as "aduer-" at the line end, and the long s is normalised to plain s throughout.
